description.shortText: A decentralized model of care that combines real-time data analytics and remote diagnosis as an alternative to current hospitalization systems.

attachments.name: How To Democratize Healthcare: AI Gives Everyone The Very Best Doctor
attachments.description: When it comes to AI and healthcare, it’s actually the status quo we should be afraid of, argues Vijay Pande of Andreessen Horowitz. Without these new technological tools, inequality will continue getting worse.

attachments.name: How Telemedicine Carried One Remote Hospital to the Cutting Edge
attachments.description: Copper Queen Community Hospital saw the value of investing in clinical telemedicine for a community of 6,000 residents, saving patients and health costs.

attachments.name: Home Hospital Combines Biosensors, Analytics, and Home Visits
attachments.description: Digital medicine collaborations are picking up speed. Just last week, biosensor company Valencell and data analytics firm FirstBeat announced a collaboration. Last year we covered VitalConnect and BePatient, another pair of biosensor and analytics companies, who collaborated in a trial program at John Muir Medical Center in Walnut Creek and Concord, California to monitor heart failure patients after discharge.

attachments.name: The Democratization of Health Care - A Vital Direction for Health and Health Care
attachments.description: The US health care delivery system is in the midst of a transformation. For generations, it was rooted in a transactional, fee-for-service ethos that rewarded mainly interventions to treat individuals for diseases. Today, it aims to emphasize improvement in and maintenance of the health of both individuals and communities.
